outcome: Prevalence of general anesthesia use for cesarean delivery
cohort: Women in Japan who underwent cesarean delivery and had claims data for general anesthesia (L008 code) between January 1, 2005 and March 31, 2020
finding: The study found a decreasing trend in general anesthesia use for cesarean delivery in Japan between 2005 and 2020.
mod_finding: The rate of general anesthesia use for cesarean delivery ranged from 3.9% (when defined clinically as L008 code and muscle relaxant use) to 14.4% (when defined by insurance claims using the L008 code only).
